At The Global Produce & Floral Show? See which fresh produce and floral programs Control Union audits and certifies, and meet our teams at Booth #851.

PrimusGFS, GLOBALG.A.P., BRCGS, SMETA, Fair Trade USA and Florverde, under one certification body. Operations that combine two programs save 10% on audit fees.

What does it take to get certified? Application, audit, corrective actions and certificate: see how the process works, program by program.

Meet our teams at Booth #851 on Thursday, October 15 or Friday, October 16 to talk through your next audit.
